remarks: Turnkey investment opportunity at 80 Meadow Place! This fully updated triplex features three well-appointed apartments consisting of one 1-bedroom unit and two 2-bedroom units. Updated from top to bottom, the property offers investors the opportunity to add a move-in-ready multifamily asset to their portfolio with minimal upfront work. Each unit is equipped with its own HVAC, providing added comfort and convenience for tenants. Laundry hook ups in the basement. The property also offers plenty of off-street parking and a private yard—desirable features that help attract and retain tenants. Conveniently located minutes from Buffalo Niagara International Airport, the NYS Thruway, shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and everyday amenities, 80 Meadow Place combines a strong location with a versatile unit mix. An additional opportunity exists with the adjoining 76 Meadow Place, a duplex situated on a separate lot. The owner prefers to sell both properties as a package, creating the potential to acquire 5 total units across two adjoining parcels without commercial lending. Ideal for investors looking to expand their portfolio with updated, turnkey multifamily properties in a convenient Cheektowaga location. Open House 8/30/26 from 11am-1pm
